name: Eclaire Self-Hosted AI Assistant
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted local-first AI assistant for notes, tasks, documents, photos and bookmarks; local-model inference and OpenAI-compatible API; no vendor-imposed software seat or request quota.
watch_out: Run and secure your own Docker/Compose stack, storage and model inference; requires sufficient CPU/GPU resources. Project warns it is not hardened for direct public exposure; use private networking/authentication. Optional external model APIs and infrastructure can incur charges.
